title: NEW MSFS Airport: Challenging Mountain Approach at Ende (WATE) Indonesia!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just added an exciting regional arrival tucked away in the Indonesian Archipelago for flight simmers looking to challenge their hand-flying skills and expand their tropical island-hopping network! Today, we take an honest, in-depth look at GudiSim’s brand-new release of H. Hasan Aroeboesman Airport (WATE / ENE) on Flores Island, renowned across East Nusa Tenggara for its dramatic coastal strip and challenging mountain-flanked approach.

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive into the details to evaluate whether this scenic Indonesian destination deserves a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ INDONESIAN REGIONAL GATEWAY & MOUNTAIN APPROACH: Located in Ende, East Nusa Tenggara, H. Hasan Aroeboesman Airport serves as a vital island lifeline connecting Flores Island to the broader Indonesian network. Named after the last King of Ende, this coastal airfield requires pilots to maneuver a tight visual approach nestled directly between rugged volcanic hills and the shoreline, making it an ideal proving ground for ATR, turboprop, and STOL operations.

Will you be testing your visual approach skills into Ende, or are you skipping this release? What is your favorite island-hopping route across Indonesia? Let me know in the comments below!
